name: approval-timeout-park
description: The ticket 15.4 escalate-on-timeout demonstration: a `human_approval` gate whose `on_timeout` policy is `park`. When the expiry fires, the approval stays `pending` (still decidable) and the RUN parks with the reserved `park_reason = awaiting_human` as an escalation — no decision is recorded, the side effect never fires unattended. The park is idempotent (a stamped `expired_at` marks the run was parked once, so a redelivered or reconciler-healed expiry never re-parks). A later human decision resolves the gate through the ordinary park-tolerant decision path, and `unpark` resumes the run's other work — so "timeout policy park leaves the run resumable via unpark" holds.
